title: Cannon Cart and Dart Goblin after the October balance update
description: A guide to the October 19 changes for Mortar and spell-bait lists, with a defensive interaction to practice and a way to check future Ranked results.

cart.text: Cannon Cart’s damage fell from 212 to 202 and its mass doubled from 3 to 6. Supercell identified the strength of Mortar defense as the reason for the damage change.

dart.text: Dart Goblin now deals 143 damage per hit, down from 151. The patch notes connect that adjustment to its role in spell-bait decks.

dragon.text: Electro Dragon’s first hit now lands after 0.5 seconds, down from 0.7 seconds.

measure.text: This report has no matched pre-patch and post-patch samples. A later weekly ranking can show which lists players brought, but it cannot establish how much this update changed their results.

practice.text: When reviewing a Mortar defense, replay a push where Cannon Cart survived. Count how many attacks it made before the attacker reached your Mortar. A marginal defense that depended on the final shot is worth testing again with the same placement.

bait.text: For spell bait, look at a defense where Dart Goblin attacked from safety. If the opponent reached the tower with very little health left, try an earlier placement in a friendly battle. That tests whether an extra attack matters before you spend a deck slot on a replacement.
